rachel: Heads-up: I opened PR to update the Vega-lite model card. Found three small issues: CLI snippet uses old `rw model` command, Python example uses `model_id=`, and the bench link 404s. Can we quick sync?

david: Thanks. I can change CLI to `rw models limits update --model vega-lite --max-tokens 4096`.

frank: For SDK snippet, v2 uses client.text.generate(model=..., input=...). Replace `model_id` and `prompt` accordingly. Short example: `resp = client.text.generate(model="vega-lite", input=prompt)`

mia: The bench link moved to bench.redwood.ai; new path is https://bench.redwood.ai/vega-lite/v1/report.json. I'll update the href in the PR.

rachel: Great. Also the compatibility row currently says "quantized: CPU" which is misleading. Infra advises "GPU supported; CPU quant requires >=16GB and not guaranteed." I'll add that note.

david: Add a parenthetical under practical limits: "(4k recommended with default KV cache)" since the table shows 8k theoretical.

frank: I'll push a tiny code fix that updates snippet return access from `resp[0].text` to `resp.output_text`.

ci-bot: CI: docs build failed - linkcheck error: /docs/catalog/vega-lite#benchmarks -> 404

mia: pushed bench link change and the CLI + SDK snippet updates. Ran `make linkcheck` locally, passed. Pushed to PR 1388.

ci-bot: CI: re-run queued.

ci-bot: CI: build passed. preview: https://deploy-preview-1388--docs.redwood.ai/catalog/vega-lite

rachel: Preview looks good. Merging in a few. Will add a one-line changelog: "docs: vega-lite - update CLI, SDK examples, bench link, clarify CPU quant support."

david: Thanks folks, will follow up if infra reruns benches and numbers change.
